page.content:
WHOI geologist who explored vents and later found Titanic.

How Robert Ballard connects

  • Item: DSV Alvin — Ballard explored ridges and wrecks with Alvin and towed systems.
  • Location: Hydrothermal vents — Ballard was part of the early vent and ridge exploration from WHOI.

What is Robert Ballard?

Robert Ballard used Alvin and towed cameras at the Galápagos Rift and Mid-Atlantic Ridge, then applied the same deep search to wrecks.

Key threads lead to DSV Alvin and Hydrothermal vents.
